name: DTU Science Writer
description: Write scientific papers without codes: what you see is the paper, and the page preview beside it is the exact PDF. Equations, numbered figures and tables, cross-references, citations in the journal’s style (Zotero, DOI, arXiv), comments and track changes, and the Supporting Information as a second tab. Real Word files out and in, with equations, captions, comments and revisions, and LaTeX for Overleaf. Free and open source (MIT); the installed version updates itself.
note: Windows desktop app: download the installer (not code-signed, so Windows asks once: More info, Run anyway).
